history.overview: The Rifts represent the deepest and most violent Discord ruptures in Kuua.

timeline.name: Major Rift Formation
timeline.description: Massive rifts tore open the terrain, creating deep chasms.

timeline.name: Gravity Collapse
timeline.description: Gravity began warping unpredictably across the region.

timeline.name: Storm Era
timeline.description: Arcane storms surged constantly, reshaping the landscape.

timeline.name: Void Manifestations
timeline.description: Void entities emerged from the deepest rifts.
